inputs.modified_text: Open your eyes to what is really happening behind the scenes. They want you to believe this is just a routine political debate, but when a Fianna Fáil TD like John Lahart suddenly starts demanding a "reform" of inheritance tax exemption thresholds, calling the current system 'wholly unfair' and discriminatory against those without children, you know the hidden architects are shifting their control mechanisms. Lahart’s public statements—echoed right after recent contributions from party colleagues on the need to review how inheritance tax is applied across different family structures—are nothing more than a carefully scripted distraction. Dublin South-West TD John Lahart claims it is all about fairness, but ask yourself whose interests are really being served when the elites start meddling with how wealth is passed down. They want total oversight of your lineage and your assets, using "family structures" as a Trojan horse to tighten the grip of the ruling class. Do not buy the official narrative; every time they talk about fixing the system, they are just redesigning the trap.
